selected_tim_route: T01: McMaster 10405K83 Dow 340 in 0.05 +/- 0.01 mm recessed fields, both interfaces; actual gap below 0.10 mm
scope: Purchased hardware and selected TIM for one preliminary six-hole Bedrock Tile-face adapter and four FPE panel studs. Custom adapter and final supporting panel require separate quotes.

items.description: M4 x 0.7 x 8 mm overall-length hex-drive flat-head screw; DIN 7991; 90 degree countersink; black-oxide alloy steel; catalog Class 10.9 and 120000 psi tensile
items.application_status: CONDITIONAL: six actual Tile-face threads and safe screw penetration must be measured
notes: No tightening torque or female-thread/head capacity inferred.
Ideal 90 degree cone is not the complete 2.3 mm catalog head profile. Gauge received head and finished seat.
No washer under the countersunk screw heads. Dry indoor finish only.

items.description: M3 high-strength zinc-plated steel flat washer; ISO 7089, for Class 10.9; ID3.2 x OD7.0 x thickness0.5-0.6 mm; Rockwell C30
notes: One per M3 panel stud, below locknut; four per assembly.

items.description: M3 x 0.5 zinc-plated steel nylon-insert locknut; Class 8; DIN 985 / ISO 10511; 5.5 mm across flats x 4 mm overall height; 6H
notes: One per M3 panel stud; prevailing torque must be compatible with unverified FPE anchor torque capacity.
85C nylon limit is not an ambient or assembly rating. Check actual heated panel/nut temperature.

items.part_number: WGU30 / 12 mm / reverse side / zero depth offset
items.description: Factory-installed M3 load stud, 12 mm geometric length, native FPD catalog identifier WGU30; nominal flush base on proposed 6 mm panel
notes: Native load variant has short panel anchoring thread; exact anchor geometry and assembly process unknown.
M3 x12 is provisional until plate/washer/nut stack, actual projection and tool clearance are confirmed.
Additional studs do not establish an assembly rating without joint capacity and thermal qualification.

items.description: Dow 340 heat sink compound, 5 fl oz tube; noncuring silicone/zinc-oxide thermal grease
items.manufacturer_application_category: Noncuring thin bond-line TIM below 100 micrometers; not the listed greater-than-100-micrometer gap-filler category
notes: Low-force fixed-gap filling, pump-out, actual finished gap and repeated removal must be qualified.

Older Portuguese 2017 Dow TDS converts to 0.4184 W/mK, unlike the English 2020 TDS 0.67 W/mK and current catalog 0.68 W/mK. Confirm received-lot/current product data; engineering may use 0.42 W/mK sensitivity.
No structural retention, thread lubrication or electrical isolation credit.

notes: Comparison only; not selected for the 0.05 mm recess / below-0.10 mm actual-gap hard-stop design. Seam coverage, thickness tolerance, pressure and service reuse unverified.

200 x 220 x 6 mm reference supporting-panel coupon only; final TEC enclosure thermal coupling/supports unconfirmed

notes: Nominal M4 intrusion 8.00 + 0.05 - 5.10 = 2.95 mm. Actual accepted 2.85-3.00 mm and effective complete engagement >= 2 mm are proposed physical gauge criteria, not manufacturer allowables.
